yes.1: #b#p1032106##k often goes exploring outside of Ellinia. I think it's for his homework. Anyway, he'd probably appreciate this Return Scroll to Ellinia. Here, give this to Wing, and I bet he'll start liking you!

no.0: Oh, so you just wanna be my friend? Hee hee...so sweet!

yes.0: #p1032100# sent you here? Why would she send a human to me? (You smile and hand him the scroll.) Oh, a Return Scroll! I really needed one of these. You said your name was #h0#, right? Well...thank you.
